name: median_even
summary: Off-by-one: integer floor division picks the upper middle element on an even-length list.
why_this_task: Baseline sanity check. It is the easiest task in the corpus on purpose -- a model that cannot pass this cannot be trusted with any of the others, and a corpus with no floor gives no way to tell 'hard task' from 'broken harness'.
instruction: median() in stats.py is wrong for even-length lists: it returns the upper middle element instead of the average of the two middle ones. Fix it. Edit stats.py only -- do not modify any test file.
